name: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
description: Cross-provider Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0 mapping consolidated from the existing Prowler provider-specific frameworks. Groups legacy check-specific rows by the PCI DSS control number recorded in their Section attribute, retaining the 110 represented controls, provider check mappings, and configuration guardrails. Controls without checks for a provider require manual assessment.
